build_pose_msg: build a ROS PoseStamped message from x, y, theta coordinates and a frame ID
generate_bezier_trajectory: generate a cubic Bezier trajectory between start and end robot poses with smooth derivatives
compute_controls_from_xy: compute velocity and angular velocity controls from an xy trajectory for LQR tracking
solve_ilqr: solve a non-linear optimal control problem using iterative LQR with line search step sizing
execute_trajectory_plan: execute an LQR plan with closed-loop feedback control and preempt check on a robot base
